I’m sorry, but I don’t have real‑time market data. Gold prices fluctuate constantly throughout the trading day, so the most accurate way to find today’s price in the U.S. is to check a reliable financial news source or a market‑data platform such as:

- Bloomberg (gold futures, spot price)
- Reuters (gold spot price)
- Kitco.com (live gold price chart)
- CNBC or Yahoo Finance (gold price ticker)
- Your brokerage’s market data feed

These sites update the spot price every few seconds and will give you the current U.S. dollar price per ounce. If you need a quick snapshot, you can also look at the “Gold” ticker on most financial news apps.
